title: A balanced question carries more entropy
hook: Two stated cases: explore the outcome entropy ingredient of information-gain design.

claims.text: Balanced binary outcomes maximize the expected information of one answer. A rare answer is individually surprising but contributes little average probability mass. This comparison isolates the outcome entropy ingredient of information-gain design.
